obligation: SEC Cybersecurity Disclosure, Regulation S-K Item 106
basis: Regulation S-K governs registration statements and Exchange Act reports. The sole proprietorship and the three single-member LLCs have no registered securities and file no reports
Applies to SEC registrants; same reason

obligation: SOX section 404, management assessment of internal control
basis: Applies to issuers filing Exchange Act reports; no entity is an issuer
Applies to bank holding companies and the other organizations listed in 225.300; no entity controls a bank

obligation: Interagency Guidelines Establishing Information Security Standards
basis: Same reason: no entity is a bank holding company
No entity sponsors a group health plan, and no LLC is a health care provider
Not a final rule; tracked for planning

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (data security, breach notice, disposal)
basis: Each LLC is a covered entity under 501.171(1)(b) for its own tenants, applicants, customers and employees. The sole proprietorship maintains and processes that information for the LLCs under the management agreements, so it is their third-party agent (501.171(1)(h)). The definition of covered entity names a sole proprietorship expressly

obligation: FCRA permissible purpose for tenant screening (Rentals)
basis: Rentals obtains consumer reports on applicants through the property management platform in connection with a rental the applicant applied for
A decline based in whole or in part on a consumer report requires an adverse action notice
Rentals possesses consumer information derived from consumer reports

obligation: Fair Housing Act, tenant selection and listings (Rentals)
basis: The units are in six duplexes, not single-family houses, and every unit is leased to a tenant household, so the owner lives in none of them; neither exemption in 3603(b) fits

No LLC is a financial institution under 314.2(h): none extends consumer credit, brokers loans or gives financial advice; Rentals maintains and repairs its units, so its leases are not the nonoperating leases in 12 CFR 225.28(b)(3); accepting cards through processors does not by itself make a business a financial institution
A controller must exceed $1 billion in global gross annual revenue; combined revenue is about $750,000

obligation: Card processor merchant terms (PCI DSS by contract)
basis: Storage and Laundry accept cards only through processors' hosted payment fields and vendor-run readers; the merchant agreements set the card security duties
Chosen as the benchmark because no group-level cyber rule binds a private holding business that owns no bank

obligation: State AI laws (for example Colorado SB26-189)
basis: The LLCs operate only in Florida
